claim: A recording that starts from another state than the build's snapshot makes the ROM path check report tail reads the real start never makes; replay such fixtures by hand and keep verify-list recordings at the snapshot.

evidence.text: A fixture recording that starts after the unpack holds game data where the start-up tail sits, so the check reports tail reads; it is replayed by hand and kept out of the verify list.
nextboot.rom_paths treats a recording that starts at another state as starting at the build's snapshot, so a tail in write-first memory is reported as read.
